blocks.text: NMR spectroscopy nuclei ki magnetic khasiyat (property), yani nuclear spin, par mabni hai. Jin atoms ka mass number taaq (odd) ho, woh aam taur par NMR mein signal dete hain. Aise atoms ke nuclei, jaise hydrogen (¹H) aur carbon-13 (¹³C), aik nanhe magnet ki tarah kaam karte hain. Jab magnetic field na ho to in tamam nuclei ka rukh (orientation) be-tarteeb (random) hota hai aur sab ki energy barabar hoti hai. Jab inhein taqatwar magnetic field mein rakha jaye to yeh ya to field ke saath (with) ya field ke khilaf (against) khare ho jate hain. Is tarah do spin states banti hain: low energy state aur high energy state (Figure 30.1).

blocks.alt: Oopar ki taraf Energy ka mehwar (axis). Baen taraf do ghoomte nuclei, aik ka teer oopar aur aik ka neeche, aik hi energy level par baithe hain: before field is applied. Phir level do mein bat jata hai: oopar wala 'against' (nucleus ka teer neeche) aur neeche wala 'with' (nucleus ka teer oopar); dono levels ke darmiyan do-rukha teer. Label: after field is applied.
blocks.caption: Figure 30.1: Magnetic field mein nuclei ki qatar bandi aur spin flipping (kitab ki Figure 30.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Field lagne se pehle sab nuclei ki energy aik hai, is liye dono aik hi lakeer par hain. Field lagne ke baad jo nuclei field ke saath (with) hain woh neeche wale, low energy level par aur jo khilaf (against) hain woh oopar wale, high energy level par chale jate hain. Radio wave in do levels ke farq jitni energy de to nucleus palat jata hai (spin flipping).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Jin atoms ka atomic number aur mass number dono juft (even) hon, un ke nuclei mein magnetic fields aik doosre ko khatam (cancel) kar dete hain, is liye un ka koi kul (net) magnetic field nahi hota, jaise ¹²C.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke aise nuclei mein protons aur neutrons ki tadaad barabar hoti hai. Yeh hamesha sach nahi: ¹⁸O mein 8 protons aur 10 neutrons hain. Asal baat yeh hai ke protons ki tadaad bhi juft hai aur neutrons ki bhi, is liye protons apne spins ke jore bana lete hain aur neutrons apne, aur kul magnetic field khatam ho jata hai.

Jab nuclei par radio waves dali jati hain to low energy state wale nuclei energy jazb (absorb) kar ke high energy state mein chale jate hain; isay spin flipping (spin ka palatna) kehte hain. Jab yeh wapas apni asal state mein aate hain to energy chhorte (emit) hain. Yeh energy detect kar ke NMR spectrum (jama: spectra) bana di jati hai. Kisi nucleus ko palatne ke liye kitni energy chahiye, yeh compound mein us ki jagah aur us ke gird atoms par munhasir (depend) hai; in sab ko mila kar molecular environment kehte hain. Is liye NMR aik hi molecule mein mukhtalif environments wale hydrogen atoms ko alag alag pehchan sakta hai. Misal: methanol (CH₃OH) mein teen hydrogen atoms carbon se jure hain aur aik hydrogen oxygen se. Methyl (-CH₃) hydrogens aur hydroxyl (O-H) hydrogen ka environment mukhtalif hai, is liye palatne ke liye yeh mukhtalif energy (radio waves ki mukhtalif frequency) jazb karte hain.
Mukhtalif environments wale nuclei ko aik hi frequency ki radio waves se bhi palta ja sakta hai, agar magnetic field ki taqat (strength) badli jaye.

blocks.alt: Methanol ka khula formula (displayed formula): carbon teen hydrogen atoms (neele) aur aik oxygen se jura hai, aur oxygen aik hydrogen (surkh) se. Label: methanol.
blocks.caption: Methanol (30.1 ke aakhir mein chhapi banawat ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neele teen hydrogens carbon se jure hain aur sab ka environment aik hai; surkh hydrogen oxygen se jura hai. Is liye methanol mein do qism ke protons hain aur NMR mein do signals aate hain.

blocks.prompt: NMR methanol ke CH₃ hydrogens ko OH hydrogen se alag kyun pehchan leta hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono ka environment mukhtalif hai (aik C se jura, aik O se), is liye inhein palatne ke liye mukhtalif energy (frequency) chahiye.

items: ¹H aur ¹³C nuclei nanhe magnet hain; magnetic field mein do spin states banti hain.
Radio waves spin palatti hain (spin flipping); zaroori energy molecular environment par munhasir hai.
Is liye mukhtalif environments ke hydrogen atoms alag signals dete hain.
